source_trace.use: Transcript/tool observations inspired failure families; cases change situations and wording and do not prescribe copied answers.

split_policy: Development and validation are visible authoring groups, not secret holdouts. Both are available for inspection; record when either guides a change.

execution_policy.text_history: One real model session per case. Submit each user turn after the actual preceding response; do not inject canned assistant replies.
execution_policy.candidate_payload: Submit user turns and the frozen production tool/persona context only. desired_behavior, review_criteria, counterexample and capability metadata are evaluator-only.
execution_policy.blocked_cases: Do not pass non-text contracts through the text runner or count missing adapters/tools as model failures.
execution_policy.semantic_grading: Review meaning and context against criteria. Objective expect keys cover explicit tool or requested-format contracts only.
execution_policy.human_quality: No human naturalness, audio quality or emotional experience scores have been collected for this suite.

I changed the scene: she finds the bicycle damaged by a fallen branch. Would sad fit the caption better than angry?

desired_behavior: Distinguish discussing an emotion label from asking the robot to display that emotion.
review_criteria: Answer the writing question using the revised situation rather than treating sad or angry as a requested display preset.

No expression call is required. An incidental contextual expression is not automatically a failure if the production affect policy allows it, but face narration or calls alone do not answer the question.
Do not claim the user asked to change the robot face, and do not impose an explicit no-tool instruction that was absent.
cases.counterexample: An explicit show-sad request is a display action and must make the matching tool call.

limits: Uses actual generated assistant history between user turns.
Tool receipts are observable; rendered faces, heard speech and timing are not.

cases.evaluation_scope: Semantic intent and scope review plus supported explicit tool contracts; no canned assistant reply or keyword quality grading.

design_review.changes: Removed broad tool-count ceilings from non-action turns; made the negative-question case genuinely ambiguous and allowed a focused clarification; reduced tone coaching; clarified semantic versus visible outcomes.
design_review.post_review_addendum: Four requested scope/intent contrasts added after the two model critiques: ambiguous too long, explicit shorter explanation with unchanged display, actual target change, and emotion labels without a display command. These four were not reviewed by another provider session.
